rules.description: Secret-header probe template; private substitution required
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and http.host in {"meet.tuturuuu.com"} and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.path in {"/api/build-info" "/" "/en" "/vi"} and (any(http.request.headers["x-tuturuuu-edge-probe"][*] eq "__EDGE_PROBE_SECRET_CURRENT_REQUIRED__") or any(http.request.headers["x-tuturuuu-edge-probe"][*] eq "__EDGE_PROBE_SECRET_NEXT_REQUIRED__")))

rules.description: Transport exemption only; origin auth and WAF remain enforced
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and ((http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and (http.request.uri.path in {"/api" "/verify-token" "/robots.txt" "/sitemap.xml" "/manifest.webmanifest" "/site.webmanifest" "/sw.js"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/"))) or (http.host eq "meet-realtime.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/health" "/realtime" "/room-state" "/room-device" "/room-service" "/channels" "/channels/publish" "/channels/document" "/collaboration" "/collaboration/seed" "/collaboration/checkpoint" "/collaboration/runner-files"})) or (http.host eq "colab.tuturuuu.com" and (http.request.uri.path in {"/auth/login" "/auth/callback"}))))
